data_a.situation: JC-5233's rewind must be specified as one of two already-costed options, and Calder Vossine will only raise a purchase order for the option named in the message.
known_facts: JC-5233 currently uses a worn line-shaft rewind.
Two rewind options were costed: an automatic pulley-weight arrangement, and a restored two-crank manual arrangement.
Calder Vossine asked for a message that names the selected option so parts can be ordered for the September stoppage.
A selection has been made. The selected option is not named in this packet.
constraints: Do not order parts until the selected rewind option is named for Calder Vossine.
Keep the note to Calder Vossine only.
